map.为什么入射角越大刻蚀越快？: Why does a larger incident angle etch faster?
map.经验上溅射产额在入射角 60°~70° 附近最大：斜入射时入射离子在表层的能量沉: Empirically the sputter yield peaks near 60 to 70 deg incident angle: oblique incidence concentrates the ion energy deposition in the surface layer, ejecting more atoms. But at too large an angle (grazing), the reflection ratio rises and the yield drops instead; this tool uses the 1 / cos theta approximation, valid only for moderate angles.
map.属量级估算。0.0006×E×√Z 是简化的线性级联近似，未考虑溅射阈能、表面结: It is an order-of-magnitude estimate. 0.0006 times E times sqrt(Z) is a simplified linear cascade approximation, not considering sputter threshold energy, surface binding energy and chemical sputtering. It is fine for process budgeting; the precise rate should be calibrated by step profiler or film thickness monitoring measurements.
